categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded after goods receipt
categories.description: Resolves the purchase order item through a standard 3-way match where goods receipt occurs prior to invoice recording, advancing the Preserve value-matching control integrity softgoal while being measured against the Time to clearance, 3-way after GR indicator.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=5 under the OR-decomposition of id=4. Advances control integrity while balancing procurement overhead.

categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded before goods receipt
categories.description: Resolves the purchase order item through a 3-way match where the invoice is recorded before the goods receipt, helping both working-capital efficiency and control integrity, measured against the Time to clearance, 3-way before GR indicator.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=6 under the OR-decomposition of id=4. Balances clearance speed with control maintenance.

categories.name: 2-way matched (no goods receipt required)
categories.description: Resolves the purchase order item via a 2-way match without requiring a goods receipt, helping minimize procurement and matching overhead while being measured against the Time to clearance, 2-way match indicator.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=7 under the OR-decomposition of id=4. Directly targets reduction of matching overhead.

categories.name: Resolve via consignment consumption
categories.description: Resolves the purchase order item through consignment consumption, helping minimize overhead and measured against exception and clearance metrics.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=13 under the OR-decomposition of id=4. Represents direct inventory/consignment settlement.
